exposure: Maternal emotional well-being (emotional stability in third trimester, postpartum emotional stability)
Infant characteristics (birth weight, temperament: rhythmicity, mood)
cohort: The study followed 397 mother-infant dyads in Tarragona, Spain.
finding: Non-smoking during pregnancy and higher emotional stability were associated with breastfeeding initiation; lower infant birth weight, lower postpartum emotional stability, and lower infant rhythmicity were related to early cessation; and longer breastfeeding duration was predicted by older maternal age, maternal cultural background, higher emotional stability, and infant temperament (rhythmicity and mood).
